notes: Presentational restyle of the customer login/code flow onto the shared UI kit (@/shared/ui). CustomerLoginStep now uses kit Field (phone: +420 visual prefix slot, phone leadingIcon, error routed through Field's error prop), a privacy caption (customer.login.privacyCaption, --fs-caption/--ink-2), kit CodeInput (6 boxes, auto-advance, paste, onComplete auto-submit) replacing the deleted local single-input CodeInput.tsx, kit Callout(danger) for the code-step error, and kit Buttons (primary send/confirm + ghost resend/changePhone). All buttons are fullWidth and >=48px (kit md=56, ghost md=56). Contracts preserved verbatim: useCustomerLogin, phoneNormalize.ts, resendTimer.ts UNCHANGED; wrong code surfaces customer.login.codeMismatch as a form Callout (no redirect); onAuthenticated continuation only (no baked navigation); send-code button accessible name stays exactly 'Odeslat kod'; CustomerLoginPage still calls ensureFleetSlug() (F-05) and was not edited. Double-submit guard is disabled={login.isPending} on CodeInput (boxes disable the instant submitCode sets pending; onComplete only fires on user input) — no change to useCustomerLogin needed. Deleted local PhoneInput.tsx and CodeInput.tsx: grep confirmed CustomerLoginStep was their only importer and neither had a colocated test. WI named only CodeInput for deletion; PhoneInput deletion added here (same rationale). autoFocus on kit CodeInput needed a justified eslint-disable (jsx-a11y/no-autofocus) — focusing the first OTP box when the code step appears is the expected SMS UX and matches the prior programmatic focus. Test-driving change: kit CodeInput is a role=group with 6 boxes, so the component test now reaches the code step via findByRole('group', {name:/overovaci kod/i}) and drives entry via click+paste (user.type would land all keystrokes in box 0). All original behavioural assertions (verify called with normalized phone + code, codeMismatch text shown, onAuthenticated fired/not-fired) preserved. Scoped vitest 35/35 green, tsc exit 0, eslint --max-warnings 0 exit 0. Only login-feature files staged; nothing committed.

web/e2e/customer.spec.ts lines 394-397 will break with the single-input->6-box migration: getByLabel('Overovaci kod') now substring-matches the 6 kit CodeInput boxes (labeled 'Overovaci kod 1'..'6') plus the group aria-label -> Playwright strict-mode violation; codeInput.fill(DEV_SMS_CODE) cannot target a single input. Fix (must be verified with a real npm run e2e, out of scope here): const g = page.getByRole('group', { name: 'Overovaci kod' }); for (let i=0;i<6;i++) await g.getByRole('textbox').nth(i).fill(DEV_SMS_CODE[i]); — filling the 6th box fires onComplete -> auto-submit, preserving the flow. Line 385 (getByLabel('Telefonni cislo')) and line 391 (send button 'Odeslat kod') still resolve to exactly one element and are unaffected. The customer e2e will red until this fix lands; outside this WI's scope (login feature only; Playwright not runnable in this environment).
